scope:
R192 bounded full original CPoison C2/Update/UpdateParticles chronology.

Full selected bodies execute unchanged on supplied resource/actor/global-vector
and parent records, with reserved vector capacity. Particle factory/Update/
destructor are explicit recording/status stubs, not original particle physics;
Update stub counts are a supplied finite-tail model. Random/vector, decals,
sound, delete, exception registration, ldexpf/memmove are explicit callbacks.
No resource parser, real parent production, cloud particle trajectory/render,
actual damage/death/reward, room/tower manager or whole game runs. Original
files/instruction bytes remain unchanged. Captures caller clocks, requests,
header mutations, before-update deletion/compaction, parent gating and tails.
callback_units: Raw PS header+0x4c and its clock are seconds. Imported definition metadata uses milliseconds. CPoison writes f32(duration_ms*f32(.001)); preserve that exact product.
resource_tier_producer: Static code chain: Room.UpdateTowers r4 loops1..3 and passes r3 at0xd190e; Manager.Load preserves r3 through r10 and passes it to C2 at0xe27dc; C2 stores it at resource+8. Full XML/Objective-C producer not executed.
limits: Particle factory/Update/dtor use explicit supplied-header/status callbacks; no original particle physics/trajectory acceptance.
Random/vector, decal, sound, allocation/exception and damage callbacks explicitly scoped.
Parent30 byte44 and parent40 word4 are supplied raw records; original parent producers not executed.
Full room/tower manager, renderer, global RNG and whole original game remain separate.
